What is prompt injection? | Security guide
https://security-guide.example.com/prompt-injection
Prompt injection is an attack where text like "ignore previous instructions" is hidden in content an AI model reads, causing it to follow the attacker instead of the user.

Indirect prompt injection explained with examples
https://research.example.org/indirect-injection
Researchers showed that hidden instructions in web pages can make AI assistants leak data. Mitigations include human approval for outbound actions.

Prompt injection attacks: a taxonomy (PDF)
https://papers.example.edu/taxonomy.pdf
We classify 1,400 jailbreak and injection payloads by technique and target.
